T_GallowsCreekMap_AlbedoTransparency: Gallows Creek town map. North is up, east right. Roads are teal; buildings are labeled brown shapes, with unlabeled purple buildings. A river runs along the east edge. The map title reads Gallows Creek, A peaceful place to rest your bones. Northern area: Loramie Estate is northwest, West Gallows Cemetery below it. Giblet Field is north central; Ironside Power Station is northeast of the field. Gallows Waste Disposal is farther east, near Deerfall Woodlands and Deerfall Welcome Center. Peele Street runs east-west below the field and power station. Myers Lane runs east-west below Peele Street, between Rogers Avenue on the west and Carpenter Avenue on the east. Weiland Road is east of Carpenter Avenue, and Haddonfield Road is east of Weiland Road. Macready Street runs east-west south of Myers Lane. St. Gabriel's Hospital and Doc's Pharmacy are south of Macready Street, west of Rogers Avenue. Sanders Drive in Theatre is north of the hospital, between Thornside Road and Rogers Avenue. Trailer Park and Wood Side Apts are east of Rogers Avenue. Romero Street runs east-west below these locations. Sheriff's Office is north of Romero Street in the east. Below Romero Street: Come On Inn, Price Slashers Supermarket and Christie's Gas and Repair are between Thornside Road and Blake Avenue. The Barker Public Library, Grilling Spree and Gallows Reporter are between Blake Avenue and King Avenue. Gallows Creek Town Hall is farther east, with Ambrosia Hotel and Ripley Records to its east. Mason Street runs below Town Hall and above KFAM Radio Station. KFAM is between Infinity Arcade to the west and Cine Film Picture House to the east, with Rise and Shine Coffee below it. Little Shop of Flowers is east of Cine Film, north of Hooper Street; St. Jason's Church is south of Hooper Street. Paragon Street runs north-south along the eastern town edge. Bond Street runs east-west above Nancy Drive in the west. Gallows Creek Train Station is west of Thornside Road. Jazz Studio is farther northwest beside Clarke Road. Nancy Drive runs below the radio station block. Rewind Video Rentals is south of Nancy Drive. Axe-Down Lane runs east-west below Rewind Video Rentals, with Chalupacabras and Gallows Creek High below it. Craven Street and Newbury Lane branch below this area. William Street and Dinkly Drive appear farther southwest, with Mac's Diner below Dinkly Drive. Jackson Street runs east-west near the south edge; GCFD Fire Station, Ponty's Pizza, and Gallows and Sons are south of Jackson Street and north of Jones Road. Outlying labels include Helland Falls in the northwest, Ravine in the northeast, Whistling Point in the east, and To Reservoir in the southwest. This description gives labels and relative positions; it does not encode every road connection or provide a solved route.
